headline: Pakistan Allocates Rs300 Billion Under Export Finance Scheme for SMEs
summary: The government allocated Rs300 billion exclusively for small and medium-sized enterprises exporting under the Export Finance Scheme to reduce financing costs and enhance export competitiveness.
why: Export financing schemes aim to boost a country's foreign exchange earnings by easing credit conditions for manufacturing and trading SMEs.

impacts.why: Government allocation of Rs300 billion for SME export financing.
